doc.name: B — editorial frames, flower market sunrise (golden hour), kinetic motion-blur energy

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: flower market sunrise (golden hour)
Register: kinetic motion-blur energy
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 4
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in a flower market sunrise (golden hour), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a flower market sunrise (golden hour), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a detail frame of hands, fabric or an object one lead is holding, featuring hands and wardrobe detail only.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 200mm compression telephoto at f/22, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at a medium shot.

LIGHT. Hard side light with 80 percent of the frame falling into shadow. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a flower market sunrise (golden hour), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a solo portrait of the female lead, featuring the female lead alone, chest-up.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 14mm ultra-wide at f/5.6, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at an extreme wide establishing.

LIGHT. Bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to high-contrast teal-and-orange with protected mid-tone skin.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a flower market sunrise (golden hour), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a candid in-between moment, neither lead aware of the camera, featuring both leads mid-gesture.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on an 85mm short telephoto at f/1.4, using frame-within-frame using foreground architecture, at a two-shot.

LIGHT. A large overhead octabox with a black flag killing the floor bounce. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in a flower market sunrise (golden hour), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 20mm wide at f/1.8, using leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners, at an over-the-shoulder.

LIGHT. Paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.
